# Provenance: lunar frame campaign datum, 50-digit mpmath oracle

- `inputs.json`: Kshana's own committed inputs, written on 2026-10-02 after the pre-registration
  commit `804662d5` by
  `KSHANA_WRITE_MPMATH_FIXTURE=1 cargo test --test lunar_frame_campaign_mpmath_oracle engine_inputs_match_the_committed_fixture`:
  for three `lunar-frame-campaign` scenarios (stations estimated and stations fixed on
  2026-03-18, stations estimated on 2024-01-01) the engine's delay Jacobian, weights, number of
  station columns and Helmert design. SHA-256
  `972d365fed970278d7f8d61b3b53035810b34406774f9049b48a8c1afd68e34b`. The 2024-01-01 Jacobian,
  weights and design are bit-identical to the `stations_estimated` entry of
  `tests/fixtures/lunar_vlbi_campaign_spice_oracle/inputs.json`. The test asserts the engine still
  builds exactly these inputs.
- `reference.json`: the output of `gen_reference.py` on `inputs.json`, run on 2026-10-02.
  SHA-256 `af19a41b39f5c57022ba5b7301cfa5000344fff5fdf1b0825780ca15fe0c126f`
  (`gen_reference.py` `f9bfc20004f3352c3f69a7860a347be2e8146f11ed67a70f5b298f9fc0d58da9`).
  One start-up defect of the script was fixed before it wrote any output: its own 50-against-80
  digit self-check compared the weakest direction as `sqrt(1 - cos^2)`, which cancels to the
  50-digit noise (7.3e-26 on the control scenario, against the 1e-30 self-agreement bar); it now
  uses the norm of the difference of the two sign-pinned unit vectors. The script reads no engine
  output, so no comparison had been seen.
- **Tools:** mpmath 1.3.0 (BSD-3-Clause; https://mpmath.org) at 50 significant digits, checked at
  80; NumPy 2.3.5 (BSD-3-Clause) for the double-precision diagnostic only. Python 3.11.15. Run as a
  separate program from `$ORACLE_PY` of `~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh` (`mpmath==1.3.0` is added to
  `xval/oracles/requirements.in`); nothing is linked into kshana.
- **Licence of the committed files:** generated by this project (AGPL-3.0-only, as the
  repository); no third-party data.
- **Reproduce:** `source ~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh; $ORACLE_PY gen_reference.py inputs.json > reference.json`.
- **Consumed by:** `tests/lunar_frame_campaign_mpmath_oracle.rs`.
